title: Chris Mellon wants to learn what CIA science director knows about UFOs

plain: Chris Mellon, a former Pentagon intelligence official, is said to have wanted to put one of the CIA's recent Directors of Science and Technology, the head of the agency's science branch, on the spot, saying "we need to figure out what she knows about UFOs." Michels tells this himself, as something Mellon said to him. It suggests that people pushing for disclosure believe the CIA's science office holds UFO knowledge.
